description.to: Wire the CLI shell the five phase-1 verbs sit on: a [[bin]] target (thin main.rs over a library cli module so specs can test behavior), clap arg parsing with the global flags from the cli design (773667dc) (-s/--source repeatable, --root, --home, -o/--output human|json|ndjson, exit codes 0/1/2/3), and the store-builder that builds a SessionStore of real adapters by source name (claude_code, cursor, codex) honoring SourceOptions. Updates the library-only doc claims (README, lib.rs) that the CLI now supersedes.
